on_screen_text.text: Trump on upholding the Constitution: I don't know
CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES AS PRESIDENT?

spoken_summary: An interviewer asks Donald Trump, "Don't you need to uphold the Constitution of the United States as president?" Trump responds, "I don't know. I have to respond by saying again, I have brilliant lawyers that work for me."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of the spoken dialogue from the interview. There is no background music or other sound effects.
editing_pacing: The editing consists of simple cuts between a two-shot of the interview and a close-up of Donald Trump speaking. The pacing is conversational, typical of an interview clip.
central_claim: Donald Trump gave an evasive and concerning answer when asked if a president needs to uphold the Constitution, stating 'I don't know' before referring to his lawyers.
intended_effect: To raise alarm about Donald Trump's fitness for office and his commitment to the U.S. Constitution.
